title: Chase launches national event to fight AI-enabled scams
dek: Chase is hosting a nationwide event to present strategies, expert insights, and resources aimed at protecting people and finances from AI-enabled fraud.
body:
Chase is hosting a national event focused on countering the rise of AI-enabled scams. The event will present strategies, expert insights, and resources intended to help people protect their finances from sophisticated fraud tactics.

## Why it matters

AI-enabled scams,scams that use artificial intelligence to create more convincing messages or impersonations,are increasingly affecting consumers and businesses. Financial institutions are both targets and first-line responders: they see the fraud attempts, hold customer accounts, and can distribute guidance at scale. A national event led by a large bank brings attention, information, and potentially coordinated tools to a broad audience.

Public briefings and resource campaigns can reduce individual harm by explaining how scams work and which steps to take after an incident. They can also shape industry practices and consumer behavior if the guidance reaches a wide audience.

## The details

- Host: Chase is organizing a national event aimed at addressing AI-enabled scams.
- Focus: The event will highlight strategies, expert insights, and resources to protect people and finances from these fraud tactics.
- Goal: Help participants recognize and respond to sophisticated AI-assisted fraud.
- Scope and schedule: Not specified in the source material — details such as date, locations, speakers, partners, registration process and whether materials will be published after the event are not known yet.

## What to watch

Watch for the event’s concrete guidance: whether Chase publishes checklists, sample communications to help people spot scams, or technical controls for customers and small businesses. Also look for any announced partnerships with government agencies, industry groups, or consumer advocates that could extend the reach of the messaging.

Source: [Small Business Trends](https://smallbiztrends.com/chase-hosts-national-event-to-combat-rising-ai-enabled-scams/)
